hero.titleItalic: a story you’ll want to see through to the end.
hero.description: You probably have hundreds of great shots sitting untouched in your gallery. Milestis turns them into an interactive page that’s beautiful to explore and easy to share with the people you love.

manifesto.quote: Memory is the only paradise from which we cannot be expelled.
manifesto.author: Jean-Paul

howItWorks.title: From a folder of photos to a finished page.

steps.title: Choose a template
steps.description: Milestis takes care of the grid, spacing, and structure — everything is thoughtfully arranged in advance.

steps.title: Add your photographs
steps.description: Upload your favorite photographs, and we’ll make sure they come together beautifully.

steps.title: Create in one click
steps.description: Ask the built-in AI assistant to generate a complete project for you with a single click.

steps.title: Share in one click
steps.description: Share the finished link with family, friends, or clients.

items.title: Templates with effortless composition
items.description: We take care of the composition and balance of every element, leaving you with just one thing to add — your photographs.

items.title: Light and depth
items.description: Soft shadows and subtle parallax create a sense of depth and a living, dimensional space.

items.title: Color palettes
items.description: Dozens of thoughtfully designed palettes help bring out the mood of your photographs.

items.title: Living interactions
items.description: Smooth scrolling and subtle touch interactions bring the page to life with every gesture.

items.title: Instant access
items.description: A simple link lets anyone open your project instantly on any device.

items.title: Days worth reliving
items.description: A wedding, family trip, or a warm celebration. Bring your most meaningful photographs together in a beautiful story you’ll love returning to years later.

items.title: An aesthetic portfolio in minutes
items.description: Perfect for designers, photographers, and creators. Showcase your best work in minutes and update your project just as easily as you grow.

items.title: A premium way to present your work
items.description: A beautiful solution for studios and freelancers. Deliver finished shoots to clients as a stylish branded gallery instead of a collection of ordinary files.

cta.title: Give your photographs a place to be seen.
